title: Pomegranate and Coriander Marinade
description: Tart pomegranate and ground coriander make a jewel-colored marinade with a clean portion reserved for braised pork or chicken.

steps.title: Warm the coriander
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the HexClad over low heat. Stir in {coriander} for about 20 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the pomegranate base
steps.text: Whisk in {juice}, {broth} and {maple}. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Stir the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Stir in the freshly mixed slurry and cook for about 1 minute, whisking until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Check the yield
steps.text: Measure the finished sauce in a heatproof cup. Aim for 1 1/2 cups total. If it measures short, whisk in a little hot water. If it measures over, return it to the skillet and simmer briefly to the mark.

steps.title: Separate the clean sauce
steps.text: With clean utensils, put 1 cup in a covered serving container before any contact with raw food. Put the remaining 1/2 cup in a separate marinating container. Chill both to 40°F or below before adding raw protein.

steps.title: Marinate under refrigeration
steps.text: Coat up to 12 ounces of trimmed pork tenderloin medallions or boneless chicken thighs in the marinating container, cover and refrigerate for 45–90 minutes. Keep the serving container separate.

steps.title: Use the clean portion
steps.text: Lift the protein out for moist cooking and discard the used marinade. Use a covered braise for the protein. Bring the clean sauce to a boil in the HexClad, then ladle it generously over the cooked portions.

notes: Yield: 1 1/2 cups before use. One serving is 1/4 cup of prepared sauce. Make ahead: Prepare the entire batch the day before. Chill in separate shallow containers before using. Refrigerate within 2 hours and use untouched sauce within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the untouched sauce for up to 2 months. Whisk it smooth after thawing. Fridge reheat: Bring only the clean reserved sauce to a boil in a small pan, stirring until it reaches at least 165°F. Thin with a little water if needed. Freezer reheat: Thaw unused sauce in the refrigerator overnight and follow the fridge directions. Nutrition is per measured portion. Count the clean sauce you eat. Marinade left on the protein varies, and the portion thrown away is excluded from the plated meal. Option A uses pomegranate throughout. For gentler Option B, replace half the pomegranate juice with unsweetened apple juice and the rest with additional broth. Both versions are dairy-free. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/6 of recipe): 31 kcal, 0.3 g protein, 5.5 g total carbohydrate, 0.9 g fat, 0.1 g fiber, 8 mg sodium. The estimate covers the prepared condiment. Add separately served foods when totaling a meal.
